values.description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at [DESTINATION] is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments.

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing:
To prevent the Shattered Blade from flooding the black market with xeno-contraband, the UEE has charged InterSec with recovering a stash of Vanduul Plating and Metal. from the old QV Logistics station the gang has been occupying. values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

TERMS*:
Your crew will need to gain access to a QV Breaker Station, collect the required Sadaryx ore, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

This will require a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Got an interesting one. Some folks who were suckered into life/labor contracts with Hurston Dynamics want to get as far from Lorville as they possibly can. They struck a deal with a people mover and got themselves put on ice. Now they just need someone to pick them up and give them a ride.

If you're up for some popsicle smuggling, you'll find [TOTAL] cryopods at [LOCATION] that need to go to [DESTINATION]. Make sure you have space in your cargo hold for size 2 SCU containers. If you use a handheld tractor beam, you should be able to get everyone loaded up before Hurston security catches on.

HD isn't too keen on anyone slipping out of their contracts, so watch your back. They shoot to kill.

If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.

-Twitch

values.title: Salvager Needed (Med. Special Order of RMC / UCM / Components)

values.description:
All right, this one is going to be a bit different. See, with everything going on with Alliance Aid, we had a screw up with our contracts and an important shipment got overlooked. Since lives are at stake, and you've already done so much to help the Transport Division, I was kinda hoping that you'd be able to step up and do a double run for us?

There's a medium scale haul of Molina Mold treatment on microtech and shipment of ventilation filters on Hurston waiting for pick-up. You'll need to make both stops, load up everything, and bring it all to [DESTINATION].

To handle the cargo, your ship should be big enough to carry cargo containers up to 2 SCU in size.

And I would double check to make sure you have your handheld tractor beam with you before heading out. Would be a huge headache if you forgot to bring one!

It's really amazing of you to be helping out like this,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping

values.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ready
Briefing:

Intel has been received that Shattered Blade have possession of a cryopod believed to contain a living Vanduul sample. Reports say that this pod is marked out by having blue trim on its casing.

Any Intersec contractor that locates one of these cryopods should consider its acquisition a vital priority and adjust their mission parameters accordingly.

Once secured, the cryopod should be delivered with all due haste to [DESTINATION].

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
